DILG Republic of thc Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Building, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, Quezon City ww-.v.dilg.gov.ph OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG Legal opinion No. 15 S. 2016 DIR. LEILA MAGDA G. RIVERA Acting Director I V, Public Expenditure Management Bureau Department of Budget and Management General Solano Street, San Miguel, Manila Dear Dir. Rivera: 03 MAR 201b This refers to your 22 December 2015 letter requesting this Department's position on the utilization of the 20% local development fund for purchase of ambulance pursuant to Item 3.1.7 of DILG-DBM Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2011-1, dated 13 April 2011, while at the same time expressing your Bureau's view that ambulances, even if to be used for rescue operations, may not fall within the purview of the calamity-related rescue operations equipment contemplated under Item 3.1.7 of the JMC. We are inclined to agree with your Bureau's position. In addition to the application of the principle of ejusdem generis, Section 5.01 of the JMC clearly intends the exclusion of items for personal services and those mentioned under Item 4.0 thereof, which expressly include "purchase of motor vehicles" from among the enumeration, viz: 15.0 "4.0 EXPENDITURE ITEMS NOT COVERED The follozving expense items that are not related to and/or connected with the implementation of development projects, programs and activities shall not be paid out of the 20% development fund: 4.1 Administrative expenses such as cash gifts, bonuses, food allowance, medical assistance, uniforms, supplies, meetings, RESPONSIBILITY OF THE LOCAL CHIEF EXECUTIVE It is the responsibility of every Provincial Governor, City and Municipal Mayor and Punong Barangay to ensure that the 20% of the IRA is optimally utilized to help achieve desirable socio-economic deweloprnent projects and environmental outcomes. The a ro riations for develo ment ro ects shall not include items for ersonal services and those mentioned in the immediatel preceding Item No. 4 hereof. Further, all concerned local chief executives are hereby reminded that utilizing such fund, whether willfully or through negligence, for any purpose beyond those expressly prescribed by law or public policy shall be subject to the sanctions provided under the Local Government Code and such other applicable laws. (Emphasis and underscoring ours]

4.2 4.3 4.4 4.5 4.6 4.7 communication, water ana light, petroleum products and the like; Salaries, wages or overtime pay; Travelling expenses, whether domestic or foreign; Registration or participation fees in training, seminars, conferences or conventions; Construction, repair or refinishing of administrative offices; Purchase of administrative office furniture, fixtures, equipment or appliances; and Purchase, maintenance or repair of motor vehicles or motor cyles. "[Emphasis supplied] In view thereof, it is this Department's position that the 20% local development fund cannot be utilized for purchase of ambulance and other motor vehicles, unless particularly identified/authorized under Item 3.0 of the JMC. Thank you. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary 99m 08
